name: AutoForge
notes:
**AutoForge 0.3.7**

- **Use the full AutoForge app from anywhere.** On the PC: Settings → Phone → tick "Use the full AutoForge app from anywhere". Copy the https address (or scan its QR code), then in the phone app tap "Connect to a different server", enter it and sign in with your AutoForge email and password. Build, edit and run workflows on your phone; it also works in Safari. Off by default; the address changes when the PC restarts.
- **iPhone:** unsigned FlowForge.ipa for sideloading with AltStore or Sideloadly. Android APK and Windows installer included.

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly
